description: A daily-seeded, practice-bankroll trainer for expected value, variance, and Kelly-criterion sizing. Every offer is graded against the real Kelly optimum, adversarially-framed traps are labeled honestly by the numbers even when the pitch lies, and every spend is typed on screen as freely reversible, priced, or terminal. Earn-only: no real currency ever enters or leaves.
statusNote: Practice bankroll only -- no real currency, no energy-bank settlement (see DESIGN.md).
